patterns.observed_tactic: Use a 3-second contradiction and a visible dashboard/process proof.
patterns.why_it_may_work: Short-video recommendation rewards early retention, completion, interaction, and clear user signals.
patterns.when_to_use: When the company has a visible operating change, such as HR learning viral patterns or a monitor recovering.
patterns.when_not_to_use: When the point needs long background, private data, or unverified income claims.
patterns.compliance_risk: Do not exaggerate automation, do not imply guaranteed results, do not expose account/customer data.
patterns.reusable_template: 我让 {agent} 学 {platform} 爆款，不是为了抄，而是把它变成公司的 SOP：问题 -> 学习 -> 规则 -> 下一条内容。
patterns.next_experiment: Record a 20-30s screen video: Neville extracts three rules from platform playbooks and assigns Luna/Fred/Snape follow-up work.

patterns.observed_tactic: Turn the learning process into a build log with method, evidence, limits, and next version.
patterns.why_it_may_work: Bilibili is stronger for trust-building, long explanations, and technical/product depth.
patterns.when_to_use: When explaining how the one-company OS makes agents learn and then produce assets.
patterns.when_not_to_use: When there is no real artifact, no demo, or only a marketing claim.
patterns.compliance_risk: Avoid naming competitors as targets without evidence; avoid showing secrets, cookies, dashboards with private identifiers.
patterns.reusable_template: 我怎么让一人公司提前学习一个新平台：资料源 -> 规则拆解 -> Agent 分工 -> 内容草稿 -> 数据复盘。
patterns.next_experiment: Produce a 5-8 minute build log about Neville learning Douyin/Bilibili/公众号 before publishing there.

patterns.observed_tactic: Use an operating memo title that promises a decision, not a diary summary.
patterns.why_it_may_work: Official-account readers need durable trust content, buyer-ready explanation, and clear trade-offs.
patterns.when_to_use: When the lesson can become a long-form decision memo or service explainer.
patterns.when_not_to_use: When the idea is only a short update or lacks a clear takeaway.
patterns.compliance_risk: No guaranteed revenue wording; separate observations, assumptions, and results.
patterns.reusable_template: 我提前让 HR 学三个平台爆款：不是追热点，而是给一人公司建立内容训练系统。
patterns.next_experiment: Write one article with sections: why learn first, what HR learned, how agents use it, next publishing gate.
